title: Reading a workflow JSON like a map
hook: The same seven-node graph in the editor's save format and the server's API format, read with one recipe: follow the wire back, check the wiring, and translate between the two.

verified.claim: The API body takes prompt, and optionally extra_data and client_id.
is_link accepts only a list of a string and a number.
SaveImage writes prompt and each key of extra_pnginfo as PNG text.
Passing the save format to validate_prompt raises a TypeError.
The save-format fields and the link row come from the documentation.
The two-way translation and the damage checks come from running the lab.

unchecked: The lab's save file is built from the schema, not exported from the editor. Real exports carry more fields.
We read the note about --disable-metadata in the source and did not run a server with that flag.
